name: Knit Your Bit!
source:
Alice is a young lady who wishes to be of service to her country during wartime. She doesn’t make it into being recruited for field nurses and feels down on her luck. She meets an old lady who is sitting and knitting at a park bench and notices that the old woman knits… strangely. 

One thing leads to another and the next thing Alice knows, she has a codename and is assigned with gathering intelligence, sending her messages as freshly knitted socks. 

If she makes a mistake, she’ll be captured. If she succeeds in her mission, they win the war.

[From [url=https://hero-creations.itch.io/knit-your-bit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝是一位年轻的女士，她希望在战时为她的国家服务。她没能被招募为现场护士，并对自己的运气感到沮丧。她遇到一位坐在公园长椅上编织的老妇人，并注意到这位老妇人编织的……很奇怪。

一件事导致另一件事，爱丽丝知道的下一件事是，她有一个代号，并被分配收集情报，以新织的袜子的形式发送她的信息。

如果她犯了错误，她就会被俘虏。如果她成功完成任务，他们就赢得了战争。

[来自[url=https://hero-creations.itch.io/knit-your-bit]itch.io[/url]]
